name: koha_catalog_api
description: Search the library's Koha catalog for titles matching filters. Returns real catalog records only. Never fabricate results not returned by this tool.

name: koha_availability
description: Check real-time availability for a catalog record_id. Returns available | checked_out | on_hold and expected return date when known.

record_id.description: A record_id returned by koha_catalog_api. Do not invent one.

name: koha_place_hold
description: Place a hold on a title. For patrons under 13, requires a guardian_token (guardian-mediated). Never call without an explicit patron/guardian confirmation.

patron_token.description: Session patron token; never store or log it.

name: patron_kiosk_ui
description: Render a recommendation list or message on the patron-facing kiosk screen.

name: librarian_terminal
description: Escalate to a human librarian for anything outside book discovery (fines, account lockouts, complaints, policy exceptions). Hands off the session; does not resolve the issue itself.
